title: Rect from four numbers
prompt: Return a Rect2 whose top-left corner is at (x, y) and which is width wide and height tall. This is what draw_rect() takes.
signature: func solve(x: float, y: float, width: float, height: float) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(x: float, y: float, width: float, height: float) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2()
hint: Rect2 can be built from four numbers in the same order as the parameters.
solution:
func solve(x: float, y: float, width: float, height: float) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(x, y, width, height)
